question: What assured benefit does the śānti ritual confer upon the lord of the world?
premises: The preceding verses state that the śānti ritual restores health to elephants and others.
The term tadvaj extends the same ritual effect to the lord of the world.
Nourishment and freedom from disease are presented as certain outcomes.
inference: Therefore, the lord of the world certainly becomes nourished and free from disease through the śānti ritual.
uncertainties: The specific identity or referent of jagatpatiḥ in this ritual context is not explicitly specified.
plain_english: Likewise, the lord of the world would certainly become nourished and free from disease.
